question: Estimate the annual revenue of Indigo Airlines (InterGlobe Aviation).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total revenue: passenger + ancillary + cargo? Yes.
Indian + international ops (Indigo flies international too)? Yes — total airline.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indigo annual passengers FY26: ~120 million (60% domestic India market share of ~170M domestic + ~25M international).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~120 million (60% domestic India market share of ~170M domestic + ~25M international).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Ancillary revenue (baggage, seat selection, food, lounge)

calculationFlow: Indigo annual passengers FY26: ~120 million (60% domestic India market share of ~170M domestic + ~25M international).
Average ticket revenue per passenger: ~₹5,200 (blended domestic + international short-haul).
Ancillary revenue (baggage, seat selection, food, lounge): ~10-12% = ~₹7,000 Cr.
Plus other (loyalty, frequent flyer monetization): ~₹500 Cr.
